description: A fictional online store used to demonstrate configurable, controlled customer support workflows.

escalation_rules.case_behavior: Create or reuse a controlled support case when escalation is enabled.

order_system: The demo uses the existing OrderDataProvider boundary with the local DemoOrderProvider. A real client can use the existing REST provider or a client-specific adapter.
knowledge_base: Approved customer-facing policy documents are retrieved through the existing RAG pipeline. Unverified or missing policy evidence must not be invented.
